content: Cloud-hidden, whereabouts unknown: that is the true address of the sage.
author: Alan Watts
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

Alan Watts understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: In what relationship or encounter can you practice seeing beyond outer masks into shared humanity?
